title: Cultivation of Human Neural Progenitor Cells in a 3-dimensional Self-assembling Peptide Hydrogel
protocol: Prepare a solution containing 20% sucrose dissolved in sterile distilled water.
Prepare a solution containing 10% sucrose dissolved in sterile distilled water.
Mix 120 μl of the 20% sucrose solution with 120 μl of distilled water in a 1.5 ml conical tube for solution 1 without laminin.
Mix 60 μl of the PuraMatrix solution with 60 μl of 20% sucrose solution in a 1.5 ml conical tube for solution 2 without laminin.
Mix 72 μl of distilled water with 120 μl of 20% sucrose solution and 48 μl laminin in a 1.5 ml conical tube for solution 1 with laminin.
Mix 60 μl PuraMatrix solution with 60 μl of the 20% sucrose solution in a 1.5 ml conical tube for solution 2 with laminin.
Prepare a 4-well cell culture plate and place sterilised glass cover slips (diameter 13 mm) in two wells if immunocytochemical studies are intended.
Dilute Benzonase in the Trypsin/EDTA solution using a dilution factor of 1:10,000.
Mix DMEM/F12 + Benzonase (25U/μl) + 1% HSA + Trpysin-inhibitor (0.5mg/ml) to prepare the Trypsin-Inhibitor/Benzonase solution.
Add 500 μl of Trypsin/Benzonase solution to detach cells and incubate for 5 min in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Stop the reaction with Trypsin-Inhibitor/Benzonase solution.
Centrifuge detached cells for 5 min at 3000 x g.
Wash cells with 5 ml of 10% Sucrose solution and centrifuge again.
Discard the supernatant after washing cells.
Resuspend cells in 10% sucrose solution to a final concentration of 1x10^6 cells/ml.
Mix 60 μl of cell suspension with Solution 1.
Add 120 μl of the mixture containing cells to conical tube with Solution 2 and mix carefully.
Place 100 μl of the resulting mixture immediately on each cover slip residing in a 4-well plate.
Add slowly 200 μl of cell culture medium per well and another 200 μl after 2-3 minutes to initiate self-assembly of matrix.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 1 hour in the clean bench on a heating plate or heated area.
Remove most of the medium but not all, using a 1000 μl pipette.
Add 500 μl of medium to wash matrices for 10 minutes.
Remove the medium and add 500 μl fresh medium.
Place the culture plate in an incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Prepare a blocking buffer solution consisting of 5% normal goat serum and 0.3% Triton X-100 dissolved in PBS.
Prepare a 4% paraformaldehyde solution based on 0.1 M PBS.
Prepare a DAPI solution containing 100 ng DAPI/ml dissolved in PBS if needed.
Remove the medium with a 1000 μl pipette and wash scaffolds with PBS once for 5 minutes.
Remove the PBS and add 400 μl of paraformaldehyde (4% in 0.1 M PBS) to each well.
Incubate the matrices for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Store fixed scaffolds in PBS supplemented with 0.02% NaN3 at 4°C for several weeks up to several months.
Wash scaffolds with PBS for 5 minutes.
Incubate scaffolds in blocking buffer solution.
Change blocking solution three times every 2-3 hours and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Remove blocking buffer solution.
Add primary antibody dissolved in PBS supplemented with 1% normal goat serum, then incubate overnight at 4°C.
Remove primary antibody solution.
Wash scaffolds 4 times for 2 hours each and subsequently overnight at 4°C with PBS.
Remove PBS.
Add secondary antibody solution dissolved in PBS supplemented with 1% normal goat serum, and incubate for 4 hours at room temperature in the dark.
Wash samples with PBS 4-6 times for 1 hour each and overnight at 4°C in the dark.
For nuclei staining, add 400 μl of DAPI solution for 30 minutes.
Add 50 μl Mowiol/Dabco on microscope slides.
Remove cover slips from 4-well plate carefully and place them on the mounting medium.
Wash scaffolds with 500 μl HBSS.
Transfer scaffolds to a 15 ml conical tube containing cell culture medium using a 1000 μl pipette.
Resuspend the cell solution several times in the tube using a 1000 μl pipette.
Centrifuge the solution at 3000 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant with a pipette and add 500 μl of Trypsin/Benzonase solution.
Resuspend the cell pellet several times in the tube using a pipette.
Incubate cells for 5 min at 37°C in the Trypsin/Benzonase solution.
Add 1 ml Trypsin-inhibitor/Benzonase solution to stop the reaction and mix thoroughly with a pipette.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3000 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and wash cells with 2 ml HBSS buffer.
Repeat the washing step two times.
Pass the cell suspension through a cell strainer (pore size 70 μm).
Collect the cells in cell culture medium after passing through the strainer.
Fix released cells obtained from scaffold processing with 1% PFA for 15 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 3000 x g and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in wash buffer (PBS supplemented with 0.5% BSA and 0.02% Na-azide) if needed for storage at 4°C.

Centrifuge the cell suspension for 10 min at 350 x g, discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 25 μl of antibody solution (e.g., βIII-tubulin at a concentration of 1:100) mixed with saponin buffer.
Incubate the cell suspension with the first antibody for 2 h at room temperature on a shaker.
Prepare a sample without the first antibody as a negative control.
Add 300 μl saponin buffer directly to the cells for the first washing step.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 350 x g for the first washing step.
Discard the supernatant, add 300 μl buffer and centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 350 x g for the second washing step.
Remove the supernatant and add 25 μl solution containing the secondary antibody (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647 at a concentration of 1:1000, dissolved in saponin buffer).
Incubate cells with the secondary antibody 1 h at room temperature, in the dark.
Add 300 μl saponin buffer directly to the cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 350 x g.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 300 μl buffer and centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 350 x g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 500 μl wash buffer for flow cytometry analysis.
Release cells from the 3D-scaffolds for analysis.
Analyse expression of marker proteins or survival rate of the cells.
Use AnnexinV/PI staining to assess cell survival.
Perform TUNEL assay to determine apoptosis.
Conduct flow cytometry analysis to detect βIII-tubulin+ cells.
Determine gate settings using a negative control (cells not marked for βIII-tubulin).
Compare manual counting of cells with flow cytometry analysis.
Count total cell number using nuclear DAPI staining.
Count the number of βIII-tubulin+ cells in fluorescence pictures.
